results.title: Marilyn's Dark Paradise
results.overview: An adventurous time traveler befriends Marilyn Monroe and struggles with adhering to the rigid rules of time travel.

results.title: Remnant
results.overview: Ten years ago, Anna’s father disappeared, a fugitive wanted for mass murder. Two days ago, her estranged mother mysteriously died. But when Anna inherits her childhood home, a malicious demonic presence forces her to confront the terrifying truth of her family legacy.

results.title: From me, Your little poet
results.overview: A poet who brought his wife back to life through poetry.

results.title: An Ordinary Day
results.overview: A married woman reflects on her life and decides to get away from her city and start a new life. leaving a drunk husband and a young boy. But can she?

results.title: Symbiotica
results.overview: When Margerie Dollop gives birth to her unconventional baby, she is met with an impossible decision once something starts knocking from its insides.

results.title: Fashion House
results.overview: Otto, a young man working at a Moscow fashion house, is preparing for his wedding to his fiancée, Maria. At one of the shows, he meets a teacher he had a crush on in his youth. Their feelings are rekindled. This relationship leads to a series of problems and misfortunes, culminating in a murder in the very heart of the fashion house. This story has narrators—they debate throughout the film the artistic direction of scenes, the genre, and even the color scheme of the characters' outfits. Whether it's a classic detective story, a French comedy, or surrealism in fashionable tones—the viewer will have to decide at the very end.

results.title: Press Enter to finish the day
results.original_title: Press Enter to finish the day
results.overview: Through the testimony of an employee haunted by work-related dreams, this film explores how work seeps into our nights, affecting our mental health. Meanwhile, video games offer a refuge where players eagerly embrace challenges and missions, often within virtual spaces that replicate the very workplaces at the root of their suffering.

results.title: Pulling The Strings
results.overview: ‌‌‌‌‌‌‌‌‌‌ ‌‌‌‌‌While performing the role of Oedipus on stage, a string puppet decides to break the cycle and not simply accept his fate. In doing so, he defies his creator, only to realize that the creator is but a mere creation herself.

results.title: Proposals for the Interpretation of a Dream
results.original_title: Proposals for the Interpretation of a Dream
results.overview: A young woman is plagued by a recurring dream of a mysterious house.

results.title: Garividi Lakshmi
results.overview: A gifted folk singer from North Andhra rises to fame through her captivating voice and Burra Katha performances, only to mysteriously disappear at the height of her popularity. Years later, a man sets out to unravel the mystery. What happened to Garividi Lakshmi?

results.title: No Longer Humans
results.overview: After death inexplicably vanishes from the world, Baron, a drifting trans teen, is pulled into a night of disoriented desire and unraveling violence — where chosen family, fractured identity, and buried memories collide in the horror of becoming no longer human.

results.title: 7 Miles Out
results.overview: After her father's suicide in 1977, 11-year-old Ann struggles with grief, alcoholism, and promiscuity. Exploring her sexuality and self-destruction, she finds solace in art, overcomes family secrets, and achieves acclaim as a filmmaker.

results.title: Marrow
results.overview: Madison's hopeless lesbian crush on her straight and taken roommate takes a dark turn when she learns of an arcane recipe for a love potion - one that calls for her own bones.

results.title: A Life, A Manifesto
results.overview: The life of Michèle Firk — a trailblazing French journalist, film critic, aspiring director and communist activist involved in various liberation struggles in the second half of the 20th century — as told by narrator Alice Diop, modern day French director.

results.title: Liz Here Now
results.overview: Liz Baxter, who works as a nanny for a prominent, has a white family in Oakland, California, during the rise of the Black Panther Party in 1967. When Liz discovers that the Connor children are suffering under the hand of their mother, Jane, and attempts to step in to protect the children, she’s accused of participating in a Black Panther conspiracy.

results.title: Seyran Ateş: Sex, Revolution and Islam
results.original_title: Seyran Ateş: Sex, Revolution and Islam
results.overview: The exemplary humanitarian work of Turkish-German radical feminist, lawyer, and imam, Seyran Ateş is the central focus of this compelling and revealing documentary. As a young Muslim girl in Berlin, Seyran grew up experiencing Islamic repression. Since then, she has dedicated herself to reforming Islam, opening the first mosque with no gender segregation and educating and empowering LGBTQ Muslim youth to embrace their sexuality. The film reveals a determined woman, one willing to put her life on the line in the name of religious reform and sexual freedom.

results.title: Scala Milan AC
results.overview: Some teenagers sign up for the contest: "Describe your neighborhood", whose first prize is a trip to Milan. As the youngsters are football fans and fans of Milan AC, they decide to describe the neighbourhood with a rap song, and record a video. Archie Shepp, who also lives in the neighbourhood, watches them and decides to give them a hand.

results.title: This Is an Address
results.overview: Stonewall veterans (including prominent trans activist Sylvia Rivera) and HIV-positive New Yorkers take up residency on the Hudson River piers as cranes raze vacant buildings for a new skyline.
